title: GSoC Seminar
text:
IIT Kharagpur has an active community of students who participate in Google Summer of Code. The students and mentors help organize GSoC Introductory Seminar each year to discuss the procedure and help freshers to apply for GSoC.

 GSoC Seminar 2016 

== GSoC Seminar 2017 ==
